args.title: Fix date presets picking tomorrow's date in the evening due to UTC offset
args.body:
File: src/components/DateRangePicker.tsx

Use UTC-based date calculations or the user's local date when instantiating `today` in `thisMonth` and `lastDays` presets, preventing evening offset rollovers caused by `new Date()` defaulting to local time while ISO date formatting uses UTC.
